trap.label: used to × passado simples
trap.wrong: She used to walk there yesterday.
trap.why: Em português “costumava” e “andou” convivem. Em inglês, used to não pode ser usado com tempo definido (yesterday); fato específico = Past Simple.

mcq.q: Which is correct? (used to × passado simples)
opts: I used to go last Monday.
I use to go last Monday.

fix.wrong: I used to go there yesterday.
People are used to write letters.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I went there every day when I was young.” (used to)
rewrite.answer: I used to go there every day when I was young.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no Past Simple: “She used to walk there yesterday.”
Corrija o tempo: “Yesterday she used to walk there.”
